DECLARE @In_Created_Date VARCHAR(8)
DECLARE @In_Created_Time VARCHAR(4)
DECLARE @In_Created_Seconds VARCHAR(2)
DECLARE @IN_Vendorname VARCHAR(255)


SET @In_Created_Date = CONVERT(CHAR(8),GETDATE(),112)

SET @In_Created_Time = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE())), 2) + RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(MINUTE, GETDATE())), 2)

SET @In_Created_Seconds = RIGHT('00' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2), DATEPART(SECOND, GETDATE())), 2)

SET @IN_Vendorname = @0 

if (@IN_Vendorname = 'ESMF')
BEGIN
Select Filename= CONCAT('ANT_MDESMF_', @In_Created_Date, @In_Created_Time,@In_Created_Seconds,'.txt')
END 
if (@IN_Vendorname = 'WELLPOINT')
BEGIN
Select Filename = CONCAT('WPN_MDESMF_', @In_Created_Date, @In_Created_Time,@In_Created_Seconds,'.txt')
END
